card.name: Punctuation ending study-method sentences
card.fires_on: Periods or commas right after a sentence describing how study participants were assigned, treated or followed, or after a patient's dose and event. The next sentence usually gives results.

modes.description: A period closing a sentence about who was enrolled or what they did, over a stated time span.
